s.note: no, mon, just hungry for a taste of home
s.how: Fry 400g beef mince with an onion, thyme, half a chopped scotch bonnet, 1 tsp allspice and 1 tsp curry powder, then cool. Cut 3 sheets shortcrust into rounds, brush with turmeric water, fill, fold and crimp. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

s.n: Plantain chips with lime chilli mayo
s.note: a taste of home in the snow
s.how: Peel 3 green plantains by scoring the skin lengthways and prising it off. Slice very thin with a mandoline. Heat 1L vegetable oil to 175C and fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp, then drain on paper towel. Toss with salt mixed with the zest of 1 lime. Stir 150g mayo with the juice of 1 lime and a quarter of a scotch bonnet, finely chopped, for dipping.

m.note: home in Jamaica, eaten in the Calgary snow
m.how: Blitz 2 scotch bonnets, 2 tsp allspice, thyme, 4 spring onions, 3 garlic cloves and lime juice into a paste. Marinate 4 chicken marylands overnight. Grill slowly over coals until charred and cooked through. Cook 300g rice with a tin of kidney beans and coconut milk.

w.how: Heat the oven to 180C and line a 20 by 30cm tray. Beat 125g soft butter with 200g brown sugar, then add 2 eggs. Stir in 250g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp nutmeg, 1 tsp ground ginger, 100g desiccated coconut and 250ml coconut milk. Bake 35 minutes. Simmer the juice of 2 limes with 80g sugar for 3 minutes and pour over the warm cake. Serve with whipped coconut cream.

d.note: named for the sled, peace be the journey
d.how: Bring 1.2L water to the boil with 30g dried hibiscus flowers, a 5cm piece of sliced ginger, 4 cloves and the peel of an orange. Turn off the heat and steep for 1 hour, then strain. Stir in 120g caster sugar until dissolved and chill. Mix with 300ml pineapple juice and the juice of 2 limes. Pour over ice and garnish with orange slices.
